summary: Frontend-only test of the new Tacho reference-dropdown + broadened file-upload feature. Login as manager@haulcheck.co.uk verified. Pre-req seeding: created a Driver ('TEST Driver 1783512018') via /drivers add-driver-button/drv-name/save-driver-button and a Vehicle ('TE80 XYZ') via /vehicles add-vehicle-button/veh-registration/save-vehicle-button. Tacho form add-tacho-button dialog: default source_type=Driver Card, tacho-reference SelectTrigger populated ONLY with the driver names from /api/drivers (verified: ['TEST Driver 1783512018']). Validation: clicking save-tacho-button with no reference selected shows sonner toast 'Select a driver' and no record is created. Selected the driver, filled tacho-last (2026-01-01) + tacho-infringements=1, uploaded a .ddd file via tacho-upload-input (accept attr verified='image/*,application/pdf,.ddd,.tgd,.c1b,.v1b,.dtc,.esm,.tgz' — thumbnail rendered in tacho-upload-list), saved → new tacho-card 'Driver Card / TEST Driver 1783512018 / Every 28 days' created with 1 infringement badge and attachment thumbnail visible on the card via AttachmentThumbs. Switched tacho-type-select to 'Vehicle Unit' → frequency auto-updated 28→90, tacho-reference now lists vehicle registrations (['AB12 CDE','TEST7191','TE80 XYZ']) instead of drivers. Verified reset behaviour: picked TE80 XYZ under Vehicle Unit, switched back to Driver Card via tacho-type-select — tacho-reference SelectValue became empty (placeholder shown). Vehicle Unit validation: 'Select a vehicle' toast appears when reference is empty. Selected TE80 XYZ + last download → save created a Vehicle Unit tacho-card with 'Every 90 days'. Edit preselection: clicking edit-tacho-button on the seeded John Smith Driver Card record shows 'John Smith' preselected in tacho-reference even though John Smith is NOT a real driver in /api/drivers (the current-reference-first spread of options makes it appear at the top of the dropdown alongside 'TEST Driver 1783512018'); saving retained it (toast 'Record updated'). Regression smoke: /dashboard, /calendar, /vehicles, /drivers, /tacho all load with no error-boundary text. logout-button returns to /login. Test data cleaned up via API (2 test tacho records, 1 test driver, 1 test vehicle deleted, all HTTP 200; seeded John Smith record left untouched).

design_issues.screen: Tacho Add dialog file upload label
issues: FileUpload label still reads 'Upload photos / scans (image or PDF)' even when Tacho passes a broader accept including .ddd/.tgd/.c1b/.v1b/.dtc/.esm/.tgz. The label is hard-coded in FileUpload.js line 41 rather than derived from a prop, so tacho users won't know the drop zone will accept tacho binary files. Minor UX confusion — suggest adding a `label` prop to FileUpload and pass 'Upload tacho files (.ddd/.tgd/.c1b/.v1b/image/PDF)' from Tacho.js.

action_items: (Optional / minor) Fix React 'Select is changing from uncontrolled to controlled' warning emitted by the tacho-reference Select in Tacho.js. Cause: `value={form.reference || undefined}` — when reference is '' this evaluates to undefined (uncontrolled) then becomes a string on selection (controlled). Use `value={form.reference}` and rely on the placeholder in SelectValue, or use `value={form.reference || ''}` and add `<SelectItem value=''>` handling — pick the shadcn-friendly pattern. Not user-facing but pollutes console.
(Optional UX) Make FileUpload's drop-zone label configurable (see design_issues) so the Tacho screen surfaces the broader accepted extensions.
(Pre-existing, from iteration_8) Suppress benign 'ResizeObserver loop' warning that pops the CRA error overlay in dev — hurts automation but harmless to users.
critical_code_review_comments: Tacho.js line 122: `Select value={form.reference || undefined}` triggers the React controlled/uncontrolled warning on every render where reference toggles from '' to a value. Use empty-string sentinel or always-controlled pattern.

Tacho.js line 125: `[...new Set([...(form.reference ? [form.reference] : []), ...refOptions])]` correctly preserves the current-reference value (e.g. seeded 'John Smith') even when it's not in the drivers/vehicles list — good defensive coding. However when reference happens to match an existing driver/vehicle it lists them at the top out of alphabetical order. Cosmetic.
Tacho.js setType (line 36) resets `reference: ''` on every source-type change — matches the spec and was verified end-to-end.
FileUpload.js line 41: hard-coded label 'Upload photos / scans (image or PDF)' does not reflect the `accept` prop when Tacho passes tacho-specific extensions. Consider making label a prop.

FileUpload.js line 23: `onChange([...attachments, ...uploaded])` inside a for-loop-of-awaits is fine but if the user picks 10 files the toast fires only once at the end — acceptable. If any single file fails mid-batch, all previously uploaded ones are lost because the catch bails out before onChange runs. Minor robustness issue.
Tacho.js load() (line 26-30): three sequential awaits — could be parallelised with Promise.all for slightly faster initial paint. Minor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the 8 acceptance criteria in the review request

seed_data_creation: During test: created 1 driver ('TEST Driver 1783512018'), 1 vehicle ('TE80 XYZ'), 2 tacho records (1 Driver Card, 1 Vehicle Unit). ALL cleaned up via API DELETE at the end (all responded 200). Also touched seeded 'John Smith' tacho record via edit → save (no field changes) — its data is unchanged. Vehicles AB12 CDE and TEST7191 (from earlier iterations) left in place.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tacho reference dropdown + broadened file-upload accept are fully verified. Key selectors: tacho-type-select (SelectTrigger — click, then click [role=option]:has-text('Driver Card'|'Vehicle Unit')), tacho-reference (SelectTrigger — same pattern; use `await page.wait_for_timeout(400)` after opening because it's inside a Dialog and animation intercepts clicks). Validation toasts: 'Select a driver' / 'Select a vehicle'. tacho-upload-input accept string: image/*,application/pdf,.ddd,.tgd,.c1b,.v1b,.dtc,.esm,.tgz — any of these upload via /api/upload and render a thumbnail (FileText icon for non-image). The Manager account has 3 tacho records now → only seeded John Smith remains. Any Vehicle Unit tacho created will list AB12 CDE / TEST7191 in the dropdown by default (pre-existing vehicles). Note: use the auth-URL pattern (?auth= query param) rather than Authorization header for FileUpload thumb src — already correctly implemented.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified. Single non-blocking finding is the React warning about controlled/uncontrolled Select (see action_items) and a minor UX inconsistency where FileUpload's on-screen label doesn't reflect the accept prop.
